findings.detail: Actual leaf investment rows disclose Fair Value as a dash/zero, but B01 coverage shows those fair value leaves as missing rather than normalized to zero.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate fair-value coverage flag. Raw SOI grids contain actual investment leaf rows, not merely headers, where the Fair Value column is present but displays a dash/zero, for example A.C.N. 664 616 371 Pty Ltd in table 49 row 6, Ranch Bidco B.V. in table 49 row 18, and SDB HOLDCO, LLC in table 68 row 17. The bundle reports only 1189/1286 leaves with fair_value (92.46% versus the 95% threshold) and 97 residual rows with zero residual fair value, matching a dash-to-zero extraction gap rather than a source absence. Because the source has fair-value cells for these leaves, the missing extracted fair_value is a real data error.
